title: Stracciatella Bao Bites
description: A twist on traditional bao, these bite-sized snacks fill crispy bao dough with rich stracciatella and sweet cheese.
instructions: Preheat a deep frying pan or a deep fryer to 180°C (350°F).
Cut the bao dough into small squares.
Heat the vegetable oil in the pan over medium heat.
Fry the bao dough squares in batches until golden brown.
Drain the fried bao on paper towels.
In a separate pan, melt the stracciatella over low heat.
Add the shredded cheese and stir until melted and smooth.
Add the dense milk and stir until combined.
Add the Malaysian chili sauce (if using) and stir to combine.
Assemble the bao bites by placing a spoonful of the stracciatella mixture onto a fried bao square.
